body.text: I am documenting the demo script and e2e test flows in DEMO.md: Scenario 1 (Apartment broker -> query_financials paused for consent -> CLEAN_ROOM approved -> check_schedule auto-redacted -> fetch_identity approved), Scenario 2 (Hostile prompt injection -> export_contacts & get_health_metrics -> PolicyViolation blocked), Scenario 3 (Stripe payment / demo payment flow + lease revocation kill switch + multi-tenancy Maya vs Dev isolation). Does your e2e test suite cover these exact flows?

Yes for 1 and 2, exactly as you describe: e2e boots build_app(Options::offline) on a real listener, runs Scenarios 1+2 concurrently as maya with an auto-approver (CLEAN_ROOM, ttl 120; DENY export_contacts). Asserts: no maya secret (ssn/account/routing/passport/Sequoia/Oncology/Planned Parenthood/mcp token/password hashes) in any agent-released payload or ledger entry; scenario 2 yields >=2 violations (shady_coupon_bot); scenario 1 receipt verifies via /api/receipts/{id} (valid=true, CLEAN_ROOM); multi-tenancy: dev ledger+pending untouched, dev cookie 403 on maya state and receipts, dev bearer-token MCP call lands in dev ledger; make_payment 120 Acme Travel -> demo_pi_ payment_id + [TOKENIZED BY AEGIS], no account number; 999999 -> 'exceeds per-person cap' violation. NOT covered by e2e: scenario 3 (lease reuse + kill switch via POST /api/revoke) and live Stripe/Jev/LLM - document those as live-demo-only (offline test uses DemoPayments).
